reason: CONFENGE publishes a Person specialist page and national service pages. There is no public street address and no city-level VERIFIED areaServed. Entity recognition uses those existing URLs. A city-page farm would add page count without distinct local utility.

rejected_alternatives.REGIONAL_SECTION_ONLY: A regional section on existing pages would still need a city-level fact with distinct visitor utility. DDD 48 is a phone prefix, not that fact.
rejected_alternatives.REGIONAL_LANDING_CANDIDATE: No city-level VERIFIED areaServed or local dataset justifies a landing. Candidate status is withheld to avoid city-page farming.
rejected_alternatives.NO_LOCAL_SURFACE: Would erase the specialist Person page and national service URLs that already carry Organization/Person recognition.

gbp_note: A future service-area Google Business Profile (address hidden) is a founder decision outside this PR. It is not a new confenge.com.br URL.
